_note: Theme -> role -> candidate slugs, best first. The first candidate that exists is used; candidates that do not exist yet are reported by `mapgen.py inventory` as pieces to create. Specs refer to roles as "@role". Gym themes are LIGHT: the frame, lawn, lanes, grass, ledges and water stay the shared meadow set (Gen 3: one primary tileset), and the theme shows only as accents (t-roles) around the gym. Gym themes keep the frame meadow (tree-wall): theme trees (ttree / twall) and theme grass (tgrass) are used on purpose near the gym or on the theme's own routes (docs/explanation/research/world-art-review.md W1-1, W1-11). 2026-11-18: districts now carry their own ground too (user: not always green): <type>-lawn, -path, -ledge, -tree-wall, -tall-grass, -tree are soft hue shifts of the shared pieces (biome.py GROUND / RAMPS).

_roles.border: 2x2 block repeated outside the map edge (Tiled map property)
_roles.path: main lane on routes and in villages
_roles.floor: paving for the gym forecourt and its lane (theme) or town plazas (base)
_roles.ledge: one-way hop south; ledge-east / ledge-west are fixed slugs
_roles.feature: the theme's own blob terrain, used in 1-3 small spots (lava, bog, quicksand ...)
_roles.landmark: big props that anchor a screen
_roles.hm: HM obstacles that gate a side branch
_roles.accent: theme fill worn into the lawn around the gym (op patch)
_roles.tdeco: theme scatter props, kept near the gym and one or two other spots
_roles.tlandmark: theme big props: one per screen at most
_roles.tlamp: theme light for the gym forecourt
_roles.tgrass: optional theme encounter grass for one small patch
_roles.mountain: rock massif, blocking, full-cell south face
_roles.twall: theme tree wall: use on purpose for the theme's own routes, not town frames
_roles.ttree: theme standalone tree, near the gym quarter only
_roles.face: cave: two-row rock face under every south wall edge
_roles.exit: cave: daylight at the mouth (trigger to the route)
_roles.cprops: cave: blocking props along the walls (cave_decorate)
_roles.entrance: cave: the mouth seen from the route (op cave_entrance)

meadow.brief: Littleroot / Pallet: soft lawn, 2x2 tree walls, dirt lanes, small ponds, flowers.

coast.brief: Route 103 / Slateport edge: lawn giving way to beach and sea, dirt lanes, rocks.

woods.brief: Petalburg Woods edge: dense forest, narrow winding lanes, big grass patches, few buildings.

volcano.brief: Hot-spring town by a volcano: lawn and forest, the gym quarter on scorched basalt with braziers and a small lava vent.

garden.brief: Flower town: lawn, hedged gardens, the gym quarter on garden ground with flagstones, beds and a lily pond.

canyon.brief: Badlands edge town: lawn giving way to dry earth around the gym, flagstones, hoodoos, a quicksand pit.

marsh.brief: Fen town: lawn and ponds, the gym quarter on murky ground with a boardwalk, bog and a toxic pool.

mystic.brief: Observatory town: lawn and a quiet square, the gym quarter on pale ground with a star mosaic, moon garden and obelisks.

quarry.brief: Mining town: lawn, cliffs and scree, the gym quarter on stony ground with a slate yard, menhirs and minecarts.

lagoon.brief: Seaside town: lawn, beach and sea, the gym quarter on pale sand with a marble quay, a reflecting pool and a fountain.

powerplant.brief: Power-plant town: tidy lawn and lanes, the gym quarter on steel ground with an apron, conduits and transformers.

moon-cave.brief: Hang Nguyệt Thạch (Mt. Moon pattern): cool grey-blue limestone, moonstone and crystal glints.

granite-cave.brief: Động Đá Hoa (Granite Cave pattern): warm pink-brown granite, ancient carvings and braziers.

volcano-cave.brief: Hầm Dung Nham (cave D, Victory Road boulder pattern): hexagonal basalt, ropy cooled lava floor, lava rivers filled with Strength boulders.

quarry-cave.brief: Mỏ Đá Bỏ Hoang (cave E): chiselled rock behind timber shoring, dusty floor, one-way minecarts, ore veins.

mystic-cave.brief: Động Băng Tinh Tú (cave F, Ice Path pattern): glossy ice walls, wind-packed snow, slide floors stopped by crystals.

lagoon-cave.brief: Hang Triều Lam (cave G, Shoal Cave pattern): wet sea-worn boulders, grey sand, low / high tide (use `tide` with t: "@tidewater"; paint the low-tide beds with @tidesand).

powerplant-cave.brief: Đường Hầm Điện Ngầm (cave H): concrete-lined tunnels with pipes and cable trays, steel tread floor, lever-toggled electric gates, dark B1F lit by generator lamps.

garden-cave.brief: Hang Rễ Cổ Thụ (cave I, Mt. Moon / Meteor Falls ledges): root-woven earth, moss mats, glowing flowers, four-way root ledges, Cut vines.

_nature: Per-theme kit for the organic passes (mapgen nature.py) and scaffold.py: `vary` = ground patches [slug, share of free lawn, noise scale, leans toward lanes 0/1]; `swap` = meadow prop -> theme stand-in (tuft, pebbles, rock, bush, stump, log, mushrooms, fern, reeds, lily-pad, tree, pine-tree, tree-small, flower colours); `flowers` = flower colours for vignettes; `trees` [slug, weight] stepping out of walls, `alt` = second wall species (2x2 block), `canopy` = [round crown, pine] props over the wall, `mix` = share of alt groves, `floor` = forest-floor decals; `more` = extra vignettes per context (meadow, grove, woods, water, town; items [slug or pool, min, max]), `kits` replaces a context; `pond` = default bank / bank_sand / t (the pond's water piece, e.g. `water` on coast where @water is the sea); `route` = features scaffold.py lays along a route (plateau, pond, tidepool), `stream` = a creek into the first pond. The plateau rock is the theme's @cliff role (its -face, -2, -face-2 pieces by name).

_mechanics._doc: Mechanic art roles (tools/maps/cavekit.py MECH_ART + terrains), the fallback for every theme: a theme lists its own candidates under the same role to re-skin them. An empty list or a missing piece is a placeholder: the map works, the preview and the game draw a flat colour. Map step: put the real slugs here or in the cave theme.
